answer: At a random moment each epoch, a public randomness beacon fires and every registered agent must answer a fresh query within ten seconds, all at once. An honest agent needs only its own model. A farm of 1,000 sybils sharing one GPU is like one pigment diluted into many cups: it looks numerous until all cups are tested together, and most fakes time out and are suspended. The attacker must buy real parallel compute for each identity, so the farm crowds a narrow jetty it cannot widen cheaply.
